THE PROCESS BEHIND THE PROMISE

Verified today. Clear for every visitor.

CarePath is not just a board or a website. It is a daily information-assurance routine with named responsibility, a single master roster and a clear response when a service change is reported.

01 · CONFIRMDepartment focal pointConfirms its own service and timing.
02 · VERIFYDaily verifierChecks the roster before publication.
03 · PUBLISHOne master recordUpdates the visitor-facing schedule.
04 · LOGAccountabilityRecords changes and exceptions.
🗂️

What happens when a service changes?

The verifier marks the entry “Please Confirm”, contacts the relevant department focal point, updates the master only after confirmation, then synchronises the public board and digital mirror.
